source.template: QMH Cancer Reporting Template Biomarker-Colon-HER2 (HERACLES / CAP Colorectal HER2 criteria)

fields.label: HER2 IHC result (colorectal criteria)
fields.default: Score 0 (Negative: no staining or faint/incomplete in < 10%)
options: Score 0 (Negative: no staining or faint/incomplete in < 10%)
Score 1+ (Negative: faint/barely perceptible incomplete staining in >= 10%)
Score 2+ (Equivocal: weak-to-moderate complete/basolateral/lateral staining in >= 10% — reflex ISH)

reference.title: Colorectal HER2 scoring (HERACLES & CAP criteria)
reference.intro: Evaluate complete, basolateral, or lateral membranous staining in invasive colorectal adenocarcinoma. Score 2+ requires reflex ISH confirmation (HER2/CEP17 >= 2.0).
reference.note: Photomicrographs are from Wikimedia Commons under open Creative Commons licences. ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: HERACLES vs CAP thresholds & IHC patterns
points: HERACLES positive: IHC 3+ in > 50% of tumour cells, OR IHC 2+ in > 50% with HER2/CEP17 >= 2.0 in > 50% of cells.
CAP / NCCN: IHC 3+ in >= 10% (or IHC 2+ with ISH amplification HER2/CEP17 >= 2.0) supports anti-HER2 therapy eligibility in RAS/BRAF wild-type metastatic CRC.
